title: Chapter 445: End Of The Road
content:
Chapter 445: End Of The Road

Wang Shuo forced Rag back with one move.

He yelled at Ayub.

"Abu, take the remaining brothers and go back to defend Wana City."

Compared to Shanhai City, Wana City has more defensive value.

On the one hand, it is because the walls of Wana City are all golden bricks, and on the other hand, there is a recovery buff.

Ayub had already made plans to die on the Great Wall, but after hearing Wang Shuo's order, he still issued an order to retreat.

The soldiers defending the city fought and retreated in an orderly manner, and the army of monsters chased them hard.

Ayub also knew that there would probably be very few soldiers who could retreat, so he could only do his best.

Almost all the injured soldiers stayed behind to cover the rear. Even if they let the monsters eat more, they could buy more time for their fellow brothers.

This scene made countless strong warriors shed tears.

At this time, Wang Shuo put the exhausted Ice Phoenix into the space.

The reason why Da Huang was not released was that in such a battle of such intensity, a small golden boss was useless.

The aftermath of Wang Shuo's battle could kill him.

After a while, Wang Shuo was the only one left under the Great Wall, surrounded by countless monsters.

At this time, Wang Shuo's blood was surging, and the power in his body was surging.

His combat power has exceeded the limit.

With a strong blow, he can even kill some diamond-level bosses with non-defense talents in seconds.

"Hahaha... Let me kill them now!"

The reason why Wang Shuo can become more and more courageous in battle is due to several important skills provided by the Shura suit.

The stronger you fight: In the red pupil state, continuous fighting will increase the upper limit of various attributes, up to 1 times.

On protracted battle: In the red pupil state, the attack caused by yourself will restore yourself (including physical strength, life, mental strength, etc.), and you will be more and more excited as you kill.

Iteration speed: In the red pupil state, your agility value will gradually increase, and the maximum current agility will be doubled.

Absolute defense: immune to all attacks, lasts for 10 minutes, CD: 24 hours.

With these skills, Wang Shuo dared to fight Rag and many general-level monsters alone.

Wang Shuo alone held back more than half of the high-end combat power of the monsters.

As time went on, Rag was more and more surprised.

Wang Shuo really became stronger and stronger. If Rag fought Wang Shuo alone at this time, he would probably be killed.

Although Wang Shuo was very strong, he did not kill many monsters.

Because as long as there were injured monsters, they would be replaced.

Rag believed that as long as they were human, there would be a limit.

Wang Shuo could not maintain this state all the time.

While arranging a round-robin battle, he sent some injured generals to continue attacking the city of Dahuai.

The rain in the sky was getting heavier and heavier. Wang Shuo had been fighting for most of the day, but there was still no sign of exhaustion.

This made the surrounding monsters shrink back and dare not attack.

Rag had never seen such a situation before.

It was not surprising that he could continue to fight.

But it was the first time that someone like Wang Shuo kept attacking without even losing his strength.

It was like seeing a ghost.

But with Rag supervising the battle, no monster dared to escape.

The number of monster casualties increased.

But the battle in Wana City was not optimistic.

Despite the protection of the city walls and the barrier, the monsters' attacks were very fierce.

Wana City was in danger.

Just when everyone was in despair, something strange happened.
